turns.content: A particle of mass m moves in two dimensions under V(r,theta)=1/2 kr^2+3/2 kr^2 cos^2(theta). Rewrite the potential in Cartesian coordinates using x=r cos(theta) and y=r sin(theta).
Collect the x^2 and y^2 terms in this potential and check whether any cross term remains.
Interpret the separated quadratic terms under the model established above and determine omega_x and omega_y.
Check the two frequencies directly against the coefficients of the x^2 and y^2 terms before using them in the spectrum.
Write the complete quantum-mechanical energy spectrum implied by the separated modes and parameters established above.
